name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
description: Disables USB Selective Suspend to prevent devices from entering low-power idle states that can cause wake delays.

description_i18n.en: Disables USB Selective Suspend to prevent devices from entering low-power idle states that can cause wake delays.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den selektiven Energiesparmodus für USB, um Verzögerungen beim Aufwachen von Geräten zu vermeiden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la suspension sélective des périphériques USB pour éviter les retards d'éveil dus à l'état veille.

warnings.title: required
warnings.message: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply power configuration changes

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the power configuration for AC and DC schemes using specific GUIDs to set the USB selective suspend value
